name: Elise Dubois
bio:
Elise's fascination with motorsport began during her childhood summers spent near a local karting track in Geneva. She was captivated by the intricate machinery and the blend of engineering and skill required to achieve victory. This early passion led her to pursue a degree in Electrical Engineering, specializing in control systems and data analysis. After graduating, Elise joined a small engineering firm that provided support to various racing teams. 

She quickly distinguished herself with her meticulous approach to problem-solving and her innate ability to extract meaningful insights from complex data sets. Her work ethic and dedication to pushing technological boundaries made her a valuable asset to each team she supported. Now at Tony Kart Racing, Elise thrives on the challenges of optimizing kart performance through innovative electronic solutions, aiming to contribute to the team's continued success. She is particularly interested in developing advanced telemetry systems to provide real-time feedback to drivers and engineers alike.

 Elise is known for her ability to translate complex technical concepts into easily understandable terms, fostering effective communication between engineers and drivers. Her ambition is to one day lead the electronics department of a Formula 1 team, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in racing technology.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair, often pulled back into a practical ponytail
physical.description: Elise has a determined look with a sharp, focused gaze.

Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically against her teeth when deep in thought
